diffs.diff: header pin 1: part says GND, datasheet reading says LED
diffs.evidence: In SparkFun's board file for SEN-12041 the 0.1-inch through-hole header J1 pad 1 is on the GND net ('<signal name="GND"> <contactref element="C1" pad="2"/> <contactref element="U1" pad="4"/> <contactref element="Q1" pad="2"/> <contactref element="C3" pad="2"/> <contactref element="JP6" pad="4"/> <contactref element="J1" pad="1"/>'); the second reading used the reverse-numbered SMD header JP6 (pad 1 = LED), which sits at the same holes, so the physical order LED, VDD, OUT, GND is identical and the model's J1 numbering is right.

diffs.diff: header pin 2: part says OUT, datasheet reading says VCC
diffs.evidence: J1 pad 2 is on the OUT net in SparkFun's board file ('<signal name="OUT"> <contactref element="JP6" pad="3"/> <contactref element="U1" pad="5"/> <contactref element="JP7" pad="1"/> <contactref element="J1" pad="2"/>'); VCC is SMD header JP6 pad 2, i.e. the second reading counted from the other end of the same row.

diffs.diff: header pin 3: part says VDD, datasheet reading says OUT
diffs.evidence: J1 pad 3 is on the supply net in SparkFun's board file ('<signal name="VCC"> <contactref element="C1" pad="1"/> <contactref element="R3" pad="2"/> <contactref element="U1" pad="7"/> <contactref element="JP6" pad="2"/> <contactref element="J1" pad="3"/>'), and that pin is silkscreened VDD on the board, so the model's name VDD matches the product label.

diffs.diff: header pin 4: part says LED, datasheet reading says GND
diffs.evidence: J1 pad 4 is on the LED net in SparkFun's board file ('<signal name="LED"> <contactref element="R2" pad="1"/> <contactref element="JP6" pad="1"/> <contactref element="JP7" pad="2"/> <contactref element="J1" pad="4"/>'); GND is pad 4 of the reverse-numbered SMD header JP6, not of J1.
